title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Agents usage report
summary: Hold: Microsoft publishes licensing distinctions for the admin center agent usage report, so licensing cannot be described as wholly unpublished and admin time as its only known cost. The agent blocking guidance also omits Microsoft's warning that admin center actions fail for agents behind an actively enforced Power Platform firewall. The roadmap facts and the printed control paths and API operations are supported.
